content.contents: a nice drawing of MANA from shatterfarms (if that's still her name, i don't know, shit changes all the damn time!)

cool scythe. i like this album, because people were receptive to it despite it not being beat-heavy. gives me hope that one day i may release something more indie-based and people will too be receptive to that. we'll see what happens. most of the guitar work on this album was recorded on my phone!
